description: Fork of exp104 (Tiny sparse_scatter, smooth_mode=False, n_alternatives=1) adding the per-table local-window constraint: max_anchor_distance=64. Every table's anchor indices lie in a contiguous window of width 65 in input space, so each table has its own 'field of view' on the residual stream. Window starts spread evenly via linspace; same start pattern across heads, with per-head random pair sampling. Architecture otherwise identical to exp104: E=384, d_qk=32, d_v=64, all 3 LUTs at nap=8/n_sparse=8, qk/v tph=384, out tph=2048. Goal: see whether locality bias helps a randomly-ordered residual stream learn to specialize tables to feature regions.
